name: Resolve a merge queue batch conflict
description: Two ready PRs conflict in code inside a merge queue batch, and the queue's AI conflict fallback is on: make the later PR's branch work together with the earlier ones, push it, and let it rejoin the next batch. Never merges to main.
author: AmberX AXF

inputs.label: Branch of the PR left out of the batch

data.brief:
The merge queue combined ready PRs into one batch and PR #{{pr}} (branch {{branch}}) conflicts in code with {{with}} in {{files}}.
1. git fetch origin; check out {{branch}}; merge origin/main, then each of {{with}} into it (never rebase, never force).
2. Resolve every conflict so both sides' intent works together; read both PRs' descriptions first. Bookkeeping files (_claude/, trackers, catalogs): keep both sides' lines, regenerate generated files.
3. If the two changes truly contradict each other, abort, do not guess: report both sides' intent and stop.
4. Run the touched plugins' and apps' own tests. Green: git push origin HEAD:{{branch}}. The PR rejoins the merge queue by itself. Never push to main, never merge a PR.
Report the files, how each conflict was resolved, and the tests run.
